supersedes.correction: Cosmetic-only descendants are excluded even when they have MP consumers. Do not keep charm-only physics/animation or skin/camo/decal data for hypothetical sightline or visibility effects. Preserve only independently sourced functional weapon/optic/compatibility/gameplay nodes and shared functional targets.

positiveClassificationRule.anchor: Begin at an authoritative source assignment record whose declared type/content and owner/reference edge positively identify charm, skin/finish, camo, or decal role. The category token or folder alone is not sufficient. Retain the source-to-weapon association as availability metadata.
positiveClassificationRule.inheritance: Traverse outgoing file/object references from that cosmetic assignment. Classify a descendant cosmetic-only when its incoming path is exclusively through that root and no independently sourced functional assignment or override reaches it. Apply this to all pure descendants regardless of their declared visual type, MP consumer, geometry, physics, or animation status.
positiveClassificationRule.skinWithoutFunctionalOverrides: If the skin assignment branch has no independently sourced weapon, attachment, ammo, modifier, or optic override, classify the skin root and its exclusive descendants as cosmetic-only. Mesh/object variations and physics are part of the skin role; do not require pixel, geometry, collision, or sightline review.
positiveClassificationRule.sharedTarget: If a node is also reachable from a functional root, retain that shared node under its functional identity. Exclude only the cosmetic reference/assignment branch. MP use of the cosmetic branch does not make the node functional.
positiveClassificationRule.unresolved: If the assignment edge, all incoming functional references, or override presence cannot be resolved, mark only that record/branch unresolved. Do not infer role from path tokens or keep the whole cosmetic family open.

functionalExceptionsToRetain.role: Weapon base/equipment and physical attachment definition
functionalExceptionsToRetain.evidence: Independently assigned weapon or equipment root and source refs into weapon/attachment definitions or DefinitionSlots_Weapons.
Independent compatibility/slot-selection source branch, not merely a visual variation within a cosmetic assignment.
Independent WPM/WME/GRM/GBM/GDM or weapon/ammo source branch that contains configuration or modifier references.

Independent optic/sight source branch for alignment, zoom, reticle, or selector-gated glint/lens flare. Existing WPM_NoScopeGlint source trace targets WeaponLensFlareData_NoFlare; optic-part report records M2010 and RMR riser source fields. These establish source relevance, not runtime activation.

familyDispositionRules.disposition: When anchored by the typed charm assignment, all exclusive charm descendants are cosmetic-only and excluded, including physics/animation/model records. Retain only a separately assigned functional weapon/optic/compatibility node or a shared functional target.

A skin branch with no independently sourced functional overrides is cosmetic-only. Exclude its full descendant branch, including object variations, meshes, physics, and animations. A functional override or independently shared functional target remains under the functional role.
Typed camo assignment anchors a cosmetic branch; exclusive texture/unlock descendants are cosmetic-only. Keep independent weapon or optic overrides only.
Typed decal assignment anchors a cosmetic branch; exclusive texture/unlock descendants are cosmetic-only. Keep independent weapon or optic overrides only.

limitations: Representative declared types establish record kinds but do not independently prove assignment role; the positive anchor and reference closure are required.

decisionLabels.cosmetic_only: Exclusive descendants of a source-confirmed cosmetic assignment, with no independently sourced functional role; MP use is allowed.
decisionLabels.shared_functional: A node independently referenced from a confirmed gameplay/optic/compatibility root; retain under that functional role and exclude only its cosmetic assignment edge.
decisionLabels.functional: Independently sourced weapon, optic, compatibility, ammo, modifier, or gameplay configuration.
decisionLabels.unresolved: Assignment, references, or override status not resolved; hold only the affected branch pending source evidence.
